 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Supremecy"** is incorrectly spelt. The correct spelling is **"Supremacy".**
 
• "Supremecy" does not have a meaning as it is incorrectly spelt.
 
• **"Supremacy"** means the state or condition of being superior to all others in authority, power, or status. (श्रेष्ठता)
 
 
• **Example:** The company’s **supremacy **in the tech market is undeniable.
 
 

Therefore, the correct spelling is **'supremacy.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Passage** (गुजरना): A section of text or a route through which one can pass.

 
 
• **Example:** She read a **passage** from her favorite book.
 
 
 
• **Reconsidered** (पुनर्विचार किया): Thought about something again, especially to change a decision.
 
 
• **Example:** After hearing the new evidence, he** reconsidered** his initial judgment.
 
 
 
• **Prevention** (रोकथाम): The action of stopping something from happening or arising.
 
 
• **Example:** Regular exercise is important for the** prevention** of heart disease.
